## Summary

- refresh the Phase 0 stable-release aggregate source guard to current main after PR #653 (commit eb87c4965a8db6552af5a0901f72666129ab16e6)
- retain an empty open PR snapshot and extend the merged PR audit range through PR #653, including PR #652/#653 merged-state snapshots
- add the after-653 blocked evidence bundle with gate summaries, workflow run snapshots, command ledger, and SHA-256 checksums
- keep Phase 0 blocked: 13 required gates, 6 closed, 7 still blocking; PR #653 is no-Host Android UI/UX evidence only

## Verification

- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release tools.tests.test_phase0_module_ownership -v
- make evidence-tools-test
- make phase0-stable-release-gate
- PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 make phase0-stable-release-gate returns expected exit 2
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=eb87c4965a8db6552af5a0901f72666129ab16e6 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-653-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json
- PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=eb87c4965a8db6552af5a0901f72666129ab16e6 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-653-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json make phase0-stable-release-gate returns expected exit 2
- shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-653-current-main-gate-blocked/SHA256SUMS
- git diff --check

## Boundaries

No Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI was launched. No swift run, Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, TCC, Keychain, System Settings, or adb reverse tcp:54321 command was used.
